modules.name: Complaints
modules.description: Handles raising, checking, routing, assigning, tracking, escalating, reopening and closing of resident complaints.

requirements.title: Raise complaint with photos
requirements.description: On mobile, a resident can submit a complaint for their own flat with a category, description and up to 5 photos. A unique complaint number is created on submission.

requirements.title: Genuineness check
requirements.description: On mobile, a new complaint can be marked Not Genuine. A reason is required and the resident is notified.

requirements.title: Category setup
requirements.description: On web, a saved complaint category holds a responsibility tag, time limits and a default Assigned Person.

requirements.title: Route by responsibility
requirements.description: A genuine builder complaint goes to Raghuvir Admin. A society complaint stays with the Society Manager.

requirements.title: Automatic and manual assignment
requirements.description: When a category has a default Assigned Person, assignment is automatic. It can be changed by hand.

requirements.title: My Tasks view
requirements.description: On web, an Assigned Person who logs in sees only their own complaints.

requirements.title: Status timeline with notifications
requirements.description: Every status change saves who made it, when and a remark, and sends a notification.

requirements.title: Reopen Fixed complaint with reason
requirements.description: On mobile, a Fixed complaint can be reopened and a reason is required.

requirements.title: Time limit escalation
requirements.description: When a check or fix time limit is crossed, the next level is alerted.

requirements.title: Reminders after Fixed
requirements.description: If the resident does not respond after a complaint is Fixed, reminders go out on the set days. After the last reminder the Society Manager is alerted.

rules.title: Closure by complainer only
rules.description: A Fixed complaint is Closed only when the complainer approves it, and it is then hidden from their list. Others cannot approve.

rules.title: Escalate after 2 reopens
rules.description: After a complaint has been reopened 2 times it goes to Raghuvir Admin.

rules.title: No auto-close
rules.description: A complaint never closes without the complainer's approval.
